question: Does the apparent reaction rate scale proportionally with the mass of Lipozyme 435 at fixed reaction progress, feed composition and temperature?

batch_source.location: Main Table 1, Table 2 and Sections 2–4; Supporting Information Table S2 assays 1–4.

candidate_laws.proportional: k_mass(C)/k_mass(C_ref) = 1, total rate proportional to amount at fixed liquid charge.
candidate_laws.power: k_mass(C)/k_mass(C_ref) = (C/C_ref)^(alpha-1), alpha is the total-rate mass exponent at fixed charge; 0 <= alpha <= 3.
candidate_laws.crowding: k_mass(C)/k_mass(C_ref) = 1/(1+s*(C/C_ref-1)), 0 <= s <= 1. This is a normalized saturating total rate, including proportional at s=0 and constant total rate at s=1.

cross_validation.unit: an entire batch loading (all post-start observations), not random time points
cross_validation.equilibrium: Estimate a common apparent Kx from training curves only, independently in every fold. The paper's 40 C value comes from assay 3 and cannot be imposed in a strict fold holding out assay 3.
cross_validation.high_loading_pair_diagnostic: Fit the closest two measured concentrations (10% and 20%) alone using shared training-only Kx. Predict the two lower loadings without refitting. Extrapolate both two-point loading laws only as unqualified reactor sensitivity scenarios. Never choose between them using a reactor score.
cross_validation.sampling_sensitivity: If each stated post-start aliquot removed only representative liquid and all catalyst remained, compute the maximum liquid-volume loss before the last sample and the time-integrated mass exposure increase for a proportional rate. No information about catalyst removal or liquid replenishment is available.
cross_validation.numerical_profile: Shape scan (25 points, refine to 49 for full primary fits); exact proportional boundary retained. Wide nuisance bounds k_ref=[1e-4,10] mol/(kg s), Kx=[1e-3,1e3] for difficult trial shapes. Require selected fits in the interior with converged least squares.

qualification_rule.interpretation: Conservative engineering screen: require both meaningful improvement over the proportional model and no loading fold made materially worse. The 0.2 pp margin is the reported conversion reading uncertainty, not a hypothesis-test threshold. Also inspect consistency under the response and weighting sensitivities. No row-based statistical significance or fabricated replicate uncertainty.

transfer.concentration_basis: Compare batch loading per nominal original liquid volume with catalyst mass per interbead void liquid volume. Use mass per total cartridge volume as a separate concentration-proxy sensitivity, without changing actual mass, void volume or reaction balance.
transfer.temperature_dependence: Only 40 C has a loading series. Hold the independently determined relative loading response fixed across 50–80 C only as an explicitly unvalidated transfer scenario.
transfer.relative_rate_anchor: Reference 10% batch input (approximately 25.44 g/L). Keep measured 10%-only batch kinetics per temperature; independently also retain the previous 2025 published-rate central film model as a continuity check.
transfer.measured_water_peclet: Previous digitized blue-dextran nominal rectangular-pulse sensitivity; no new flow field
transfer.holdout: All 20 experimental acid conversion markers from Lorenzo et al. 2025, reserved for scoring after saving all predictions and batch fit settings.
